FIB-4 Liver Fibrosis Index — FHIR Questionnaire Template

Age, AST, ALT and platelets with the FIB-4 index and its fibrosis-risk category.

Open in Builder

Scoring

Calculated values only; each result stays empty until all of its inputs are answered.

Questions

  1. Age (years)
  2. AST (U/L)
  3. ALT (U/L)
  4. Platelets (×10⁹/L)

Calculated results

  • FIB-4 index
  • FIB-4 category

Source and license

Source: Shah et al. 2009, Clin Gastroenterol Hepatol 7:1104 (cut-offs 1.3 / 2.67). Codes: LOINC.

License: Original wording written for this builder; covered by the project license (non-commercial use with attribution; commercial use needs written permission). Formulas are published methods; see the source. (link)

Provided to save authoring effort, not as medical advice — confirm the scale and its cut-offs for your use case.

Use it

  1. Download the FHIR Questionnaire JSON, or
  2. open it in the Builder right away (or open the Builder, choose + Add → From template… and search for “FIB-4 Liver Fibrosis Index”). It arrives as one titled group with its calculations wired, and you can keep editing it.
